examples.text: He hath a Houſe and Barn in repair, a Field or two to graze his Cows, with a Garden and Orchard.

examples.text: HyperText is a way to link and access information of various kinds as a web of nodes in which the user can browse at will.

glosses: To move about while eating parts of plants, especially plants other than pasture, such as shrubs or trees.

examples.text: Sheep ranged everywhere under the low cedars. They browsed with noses in the frost, and from all around came the tinkle of tiny bells on the curly-horned rams, and an endless variety of bleats.
